(Japanese: '''VS キャタピー ''' ''VS Caterpie'') is the 53rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, and the 13th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Yellow}} wakes up with [[Pika]]. She then has a flashback to the events of last night, and begins to question where {{adv|Blue}} is now. Looking around, she spots Blue about to be hit by a boulder, and she starts to scream for Blue to move out of the way, but Blue just calls on [[Blue's Scyther|his Scyther]] and he slices the boulder into pieces. Blue then calls on his {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} and tells him to send more rocks down. Yellow is surprised that he is doing this for training. Yellow starts to watch Blue train more, but then sees the [[Kitty|Caterpie]] from [[Celadon City]]. Blue then tells Yellow to capture the Caterpie, and then train it to a higher level. Yellow calls [[Ratty]] out, and Blue thinks that the Pokémon could prove useful if manages to evolve to its final form. Later that night, Blue thinks that Yellow should at least have a {{p|Metapod}}, but when he checks on Yellow, she still hasn't captured the Caterpie. Yellow admits that she has difficulty in capturing Pokémon as she can't bear to hurt them, and she's been trying to find a method to capture Pokémon without battling them. Blue is forced to instruct her, and eventually Yellow succeeds in capturing the Caterpie. At that instant, Ratty begins to evolve into {{p|Raticate}}, but to Blue's shock Yellow has no idea what [[Evolution]] is, and is horrified when Yellow begins to bawl over Ratty's change in appearance. The next day, Yellow apologizes to Blue, saying that she has gotten over Ratty's Evolution. Blue points out that Yellow can cancel out Evolution with the [[Pokédex]], and admonishes her for her general lack of ability, asking her if she's really serious about her quest to locate {{adv|Red}}. Further away on [[Cerise Island]], [[Agatha]] shows [[Lance]] the Gym Badge amplifier she had found, revealing an eighth hidden section in the center where the Earth Badge could be placed. She declares that she is on the verge of locating it as Lance departs. ==Major events== * {{adv|Yellow}} catches a [[Kitty|Caterpie]]. * Yellow's [[Ratty|Rattata]] [[Evolution|evolves]] into a {{p|Raticate}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Raticate}} ({{OP|Yellow|Raticate}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Blue}} * {{Adv|Yellow}} * [[Agatha]] * [[Lance]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Scyther}} ({{OP|Blue|Scyther}}) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}) * {{p|Golduck}} ({{OP|Blue|Golduck}}) * {{p|Pidgeot}} ({{adv|Blue}}'s) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; evolves) * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; newly evolved) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; new) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 綠毛蟲|VS Caterpie}} (Taiwan)
